text:
customer_acme: Hi team — we started seeing a spike of 429s and elevated tail latency (~2-4s) during a traffic surge at ~09:12 PST. We're on Dedicated (org: acme-prod), min_replicas=2, max_replicas=20. Dashboard shows requests queued and no new workers spun up. Can someone triage? cc @maya

maya: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a failing request id + any console logs you have? Also which model/route was hit?

customer_acme: Request id r-8f4c3d, model: redwood-rlhf-13b. Console log snippet shows intermittent "attach failed: unauthorized" during the surge. Sending log excerpt:```json
{"ts":"2026-03-16T09:12:11Z","level":"error","msg":"attach failed","err":"rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc=\"imagepull permission denied\"","pool":"warmpool-1"}
```

sam: I'm checking autoscaler decisions and probe history for acme-prod. Will post findings in a minute.

sam: Quick findings: autoscaler decision log shows repeated "no scale up" evaluations. Reason: warmpool attach attempts failing -> no healthy warm candidates to promote, and min_replicas floor is preventing the quick cold-spin fallback. Snippet:```text
[autoscaler] 09:11:58 evaluate -> candidates=0, warmpool_attach_failures=12, min_replicas=2 -> scale_action=NONE
```

ash: I see a burst of 'warmpool heartbeat missed' events in the warmpool controller at 09:09-09:13. Attach attempts to the warmpool returned 403/401 from registry around the same time — looks like a credentials rotation event happened at 09:09 PST (service-account node-image-puller).

lia: We rolled a credential rotation earlier today as part of a short-lived ops change (09:08 PST) — looks like warmpool controller didn't pick up the new token in time. Reproduced locally by rotating the pull creds -> warmpool attach fails and autoscaler doesn't see healthy warm nodes. Repro steps I used:```bash
# rotate test token
kubectl -n infra exec -it image-puller -- /bin/rotate-token
# tail warmpool controller logs
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/warmpool-controller | grep attach
```
Output:```text
attach attempt -> err: unauthorized (401)
attach retry exhausted -> giving up on candidate
```

maya: This explains it. Workarounds while we fix infra: (1) bump min_replicas to 5 for immediate headroom (2) increase attach retry cap so warmpool has more time to recover (3) if needed, roll warmpool controller to pick up new creds. Which do you want us to do now?

sam: I'll apply a short mitigation: increase attach retries from 3 -> 8 and roll the warmpool controller in acme-prod canary. Also bumping min_replicas to 4 for 15m window to avoid immediate queueing. Command I'm running:```bash
# pseudo commands
internal-cli update autoscaler acme-prod --attach-retries=8
internal-cli set-scaling acme-prod --min=4 --duration=15m
kubectl -n dedicated rollout restart deploy/warmpool-controller-acme
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: eng-runtime/warmpool-fallback v2 -> canary on 3 hosts (task id: deploy-5893)

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260316-73. Title: warmpool attach failures -> autoscaler stall -> customer 429s. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-20260316-73

ash: Confirming root cause: registry service-account rotation created a short auth window where warmpool controller used stale creds. Warmpool attach retries hit their caps, so autoscaler saw zero promotable warm candidates and did not trigger cold spinup quickly because of the min_replicas floor and decision heuristic.

sam: Mitigation applied: rolled warmpool controller, attach retries increased, min_replicas temporarily bumped. Monitoring now. I'm watching the queue depth and attach success rate.

customer_acme: Latency is dropping and 429s are decreasing, thanks. We'll keep an eye for 10-15m and report if anything recurs. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

lia: Follow-ups: we'll add a credentials reload to the warmpool controller so it picks up rotated service-account tokens without a full restart, and add a fast-fail healthcheck so autoscaler will fallback to cold spinups sooner if warmpool attach fails repeatedly. I'll file ENG work item.

maya: Filed ENG-5123: "warmpool creds reload + improved warmpool failure fallback". ETA: patch next week, will schedule a postmortem and root-cause write-up in the incident. For now closing the support ticket; re-open if symptoms return. :thumbsup:
